'''Lellel''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] with a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] personality who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Lellel was the leader of the [[Jiramma]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Hutt clan]]. The Jiramma clan frequently went into business with the Hutts of the [[Vanderijar]] kajidic and Lellel used Jiramma's close ties to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to help cover up indiscretions that arose due to Vanderijar's aggressive style of operation.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
